retrievalProfile.description: A centered studio portrait of a performer in 70s attire against a neutral, slightly vignetted background with a thin header text bar.

recipe.visualDefinition: A waist-up portrait of a smiling male figure in a teal velvet blazer and pink collared shirt, centered against an off-white studio backdrop with a soft glow effect around the subject and a single line of thin, spaced-out typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Soft glow/halo effect separating subject from background
High-contrast color pairing of teal and pink
Minimalist header text balanced by large negative space

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered waist-up portrait, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and bright white smile.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the top header text, moves down to the face, then follows the lines of the blazer lapels to the hands in pockets.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial off-white space flanking the subject, creating a clean, airy feel.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, warm tones with a soft, slightly desaturated film-like quality.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for both artist name and title, separated by a dot or dash.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides a similar humanist but clean feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man in a 1970s teal velvet suit and pink shirt, centered against a cream background with a soft hazy glow around the silhouette.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of thin, uppercase geometric sans-serif text at the very top, centered, with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the text centered at the top?
Is the lighting soft and slightly hazy?
Is the color palette dominated by teal, pink, and cream?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the subject has a soft 'halo' light effect.
Verify the text is thin and uppercase.
Check that the background is a clean, warm neutral.
Confirm the 70s fashion style is accurately represented.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait subject + Velvet texture + Pastel accent + Cream background + Thin top-aligned sans-serif = 70s Soul Aesthetic
